description: This file defines a service for managing orders in an e-commerce system, including creating orders, listing user orders, and fetching specific orders. It interacts with database models like Order and Product, and performs validation and stock management.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a customer order, contains order items and total amount.

classes.name: OrderItem
classes.description: Represents an individual item within an order, including product ID, quantity, and unit price.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents a product with attributes like id, price, stock, and active status.

methods.name: Decimal _calc_total(items: List[OrderItem])
methods.description: Calculates the total price of a list of order items by summing item unit price multiplied by quantity.

methods.name: Order create_order(db: AsyncSession, user_id: int, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
Optional[Order] get_order(db: AsyncSession, order_id: int, user_id: int)
